Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

strainselect (development version)

  • prepare_input() accepts column names as well as positions for col_select, id and date, with a clear error for unknown columns.
  • prepare_input() reads dates with the new date_format argument ("%d/%m/%Y" by default) and accepts Date columns; unreadable dates give "unknown". date = NULL is the new default for “no date” (0 still works).
  • The old How_to_use_Strainselect/ folder and .Rhistory are removed from the repository: their content is now in the “Get started” vignette.

strainselect 0.1.0

Breaking changes

  • prepare_input(): the arguments m and a are renamed month and year; cstats_table(): the argument l is renamed step. The old names still work but give a deprecation warning.
  • prepare_input() no longer keeps the identifier column in the selected metadata when col_select includes it (it was used in the distances).
  • cstats_table() returns the table of statistics (it returned NULL or only the plot), and its rows are named Test <number of clusters>.

New features

  • select_silhouette() and select_profiles() gain a seed argument to make the selection reproducible.
  • select_silhouette() checks that k is between 2 and the number of strains minus 1.

Bug fixes and improvements

  • The package can be installed and used without loading its dependencies first; select_silhouette() and define_profiles() no longer depend on global objects; select_profiles() fills the size column.
  • prepare_upset(), define_profiles(), select_profiles() and select_silhouette() are vectorised (about 2000 times faster on 3000 strains, same results).
  • Information is displayed with message() and can be silenced with suppressMessages().
  • The example data data_test.csv is encoded in UTF-8.
  • Complete documentation of the functions, a “Get started” vignette, unit tests for every function and continuous integration on GitHub.

strainselect 0.0.0.9000
